purpose: Development diagnosis of interrupted CW decoding; no fresh final data accessed.

decision.reason: Removing repeated token-quiet cache resets reduced interrupted errors by 4.47%, below the preregistered 10% relative improvement target. Production unchanged.
decision.gainHold: Diagnostic only. Freezing gain can suppress later weaker stations and was never proposed for production.
decision.incompleteChecks: Standard development and consumed 34-case pause regressions were terminated before completion after the user reported excessive Mac heat. No claim of passing those checks.

rootCauses.cacheReset: The token-quiet counter can reach the reset threshold after physical marks have resumed but before any character is emitted. Three clean cases reset during the first marks of a new burst, discarding partial symbol context.
rootCauses.gain: During long pauses, decaying peak normalization raises continuing receiver noise to substantial model-input amplitude. Holding gain isolates this effect, but is not suitable as a general fix.
